mechanism.summary: Make the successful return from each hot out-of-line non-call opcode handler pointer-sized by returning a niche-optimized result whose error is an owned RuntimeError pointer. Convert that pointer back to the unchanged RuntimeError at the dispatch boundary, so ordinary success no longer writes and reloads a multiword Result through a caller-provided return buffer while exceptional execution alone pays one allocation.
mechanism.generality: The ABI applies uniformly to the existing out-of-line local, global, named and computed property, coercion, unary, update, and binary opcode bodies. Selection depends only on entering one of those opcode handlers; it does not inspect source paths, benchmark or function names, property names, value contents, iteration counts, checksums, or expected results. Inline authoritative-local and Number fast paths remain unchanged, and call, construction, return, rare-opcode, public RuntimeError, and global error-model boundaries retain their existing representations.
semantic_risks: round-tripping every thrown value and diagnostic message through the private owned error pointer without cloning, replacing, or swallowing it
allocating only after an opcode has produced an abrupt completion and never on a successful handler return
preserving instruction-pointer synchronization and try/catch handling when the compact error is converted at the dispatch boundary
keeping the compact result pointer-sized through its non-null error niche on every supported target
leaving call, construction, return, suspension, rare-opcode, and public RuntimeError result contracts unchanged
not moving semantic work into the dispatch loop or widening any existing fast-path admission

profile_evidence.source: macOS sample 2026-08-03 /tmp/qjs-2093-hash-map.sample; amplified runner-equivalent JetStream HashMap executed by release executable SHA-256 cb5702a4ae650da9e6f8a39cc6e24ecc8290d9da69a8df3c873c142319eb32d9. The current 39f3b530 descendant changes documentation only and is runtime-identical to the queue candidate.
profile_evidence.shared_cost: Vm::run_current_activation itself owns 561 of 2,543 main-thread samples, a conservative 22.1 percent exclusive lower bound before counting its out-of-line handlers. Current ARM64 disassembly gives it a 448-byte frame and passes a caller stack address in x0 before hot property and arithmetic handlers, then reloads the memory-returned Result discriminant. The same sample independently reaches named-property reads, binary evaluation, local handling, and their post-call dispatch continuations.
